description: This file defines a class `OpenAIResponsesHandler` that manages processing and applying guardrails to inputs and responses within an AI language model pipeline, specifically for the OpenAI Responses API format. It includes methods for handling both input messages and output responses, extracting text, images, and tool calls, and mapping guardrail responses back to the original data structures.

classes.name: OpenAIResponsesHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing inputs and responses conforming to the OpenAI Responses API format with guardrail integration. It provides methods to process input messages, extract content, apply guardrails, and map responses back into the original data structures, supporting both standard and streaming responses.
